def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    def segments(n, seps):
        out=[]; a=0
        for s in seps:
            if a<s: out.append((a,s))
            a=s+1
        if a<n: out.append((a,n))
        return out
    rs=segments(h,[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1])
    cs=segments(w,[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else bg for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [(a,b) for a,b in zip([0]+[r+1 for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1], [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]+[h]) if a < b]
    cs = [(a,b) for a,b in zip([0]+[c+1 for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1], [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]+[w]) if a < b]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    mark=min(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==mark for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else bg for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
PY
